parts.title: Something Strange
parts.text: Tara was never **weary** of hunting for things others missed. She stopped to **inspect** the library shelf and noticed something odd — a drawing tucked behind the books, its edges **moist** with damp air. The school had been **vacant** all week for the holiday, and the warm, humid hallways felt heavy and strange.

parts.title: The Investigation
parts.text: That night, wind rattled the school windows, but Tara was too curious to worry. Was there something **fatal** to the mystery hidden in that drawing, or was it just a prank? She began to **adapt** her usual methods — this was no ordinary lost-and-found case. She had to **plead** with Kai to join her after dark, and then convince **petrified** Vivaan to come too, because three detectives were better than two.

parts.title: The Hidden Clue
parts.text: Behind the bookshelf, they found an old map. The paper was thin and damp to the touch. It showed a hidden passage in the school's **rotation** of underground tunnels — a layout that had changed every decade since the building was first constructed. In an **instant**, Tara understood: the drawing was a map key. "This will **provide** the answer we need," she whispered. Vivaan gave a **peck** of excitement — a tiny, quick tap on Kai's shoulder.

parts.title: The Secret Revealed
parts.text: What they found was the school's original time capsule from 1923 — filled with letters, photographs, and a gold pocket watch. The principal was thrilled and announced that Tara, Kai, and Vivaan had made the most exciting discovery in the school's history. Their names were added to the school's Hall of Fame, and the time capsule went on permanent display in the library.
